title: Cyber Crime Complaint under Sections 43, 66C, 66D IT Act, 2000 & Section 318(4) BNS, 2023 for Financial Fraud
whenToUse: Use when reporting digital financial fraud, identity theft, phishing, unauthorized fund diversion, or crypto scam to the Cyber Crime Police Cell / 1930 portal.
variantComparisonNote: Originating cyber crime criminal complaint. Distinct from evidence certificates under Section 63 BSA, 2023.
youWillNeed: Bank statements highlighting debits, transaction UTR numbers, suspect beneficiary bank account/IFSC/UPI ID details, phishing SMS/chat screenshots, Section 63 BSA certificate.
legalBasis: Sections 43, 66C, 66D Information Technology Act, 2000; Section 318(4) Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (BNS); Section 173 BNSS, 2023; Section 63 BSA, 2023.
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Chronological details of fraudulent digital inducement and unauthorized debit
Suspect digital identifiers (phone numbers, UPI IDs, beneficiary bank account numbers, IP logs)
Invocation of Section 66C/66D IT Act, 2000 and Section 318(4) BNS, 2023
Urgent statutory prayer for freeze of beneficiary mule accounts under Section 106 BNSS, 2023

particulars.label: Cyber Crime Authority
particulars.description: Designation of Cyber Crime Police Station / Cell

particulars.label: Affected Bank Account No.
particulars.description: Account number from which funds were debited

aiBlocks.title: Modus Operandi & Timeline of Fraud
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Narrate chronological facts of fraudulent communication, deceptive phishing inducement, unauthorized debits from account {{FACT:bank_account_affected}}, and total loss of ₹{{FACT:fraud_amount}}/-.

aiBlocks.title: Statutory Infractions under IT Act & BNS 2023
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Invoke Sections 43, 66C, 66D IT Act, 2000 and Section 318(4) Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, citing digital forensics and Section 63 BSA, 2023 certification.

aiBlocks.title: Urgent Prayers for Mule Account Freeze & FIR
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Demand immediate registration of FIR under Section 173 BNSS, 2023, freezing of beneficiary accounts under Section 106 BNSS, and requisition of IP/CDR logs.
